note: The Mirewatch's people are tools/worlds/homelands.json's (Cazic-Thule): Elder Hsslarn on the west shore of the temple island gives the first two, Huntmaster Kessrak beside him the three hunts; Hidebinder Ssilith, just east of the elder, is the outfitter; Coachman Rassk keeps the stable south-east of the elder, short of the east bridge (his coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes); the bog beetles (the south shore of the temple island), the marsh serpents (the south end of the east island, past the gatekeeper) and the alligator Old Snapjaw (alone on the north shore, over the north bridge) are placed for these quests. Levels 7-20 (2026-11-11): Kessrak gives L7-L15, Hsslarn the L20 path; objectives on the Homelands' shared ground, the Goldfeather Eyrie (Rassk's coach): the cold that slows a lizard's blood, owl pinions for a spear, a brood thinned, the watch kept with Scout Feyla.

L1.name: A Hatchling's Fang Cord
offer: So. The egg has opened, and here you stand. Good. But the Mirewatch does not know you yet, hatchling, and what the Mirewatch does not know, it spears.
Every hatchling wears the fang cord. Hidebinder Ssilith strings them, a few steps east of here.
Will you fetch your fang cord and show it to me?
L1.declined: Then wait. The swamp has time. You may not.
L1.started: East, a few steps. Ssilith is the one who smells of tanning bark.

piece.name: hatchling's fang cord
piece.description: A cord of swamp reed strung with a young gator's fang. Every hatchling of the Mirewatch wears one at its throat.

fetch.journal: Ask Hidebinder Ssilith, just east of Elder Hsslarn, for a hatchling's fang cord.
fetch.says: The elder sent you. Yes. Lower your head. Reed for the cord, a gator's fang for the bite. A hatchling pays nothing. Once.

show.journal: Show the hatchling's fang cord to Elder Hsslarn.
show.says: It hangs well. Now the sentinels will lower their spears when you pass. Keep it at your throat.

L2.name: Bound to the Mire
offer: The swamp takes the careless, hatchling, and gives nothing back. Have Spiritmaster Thessik bind your spirit to the temple island, so that you wake here if it takes you.
Then give your name to Coachman Rassk for his ledger. His coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes of the Homelands, for those their stables know.
Will you see them both and come back to me?
L2.started: Thessik waits on the west shore. Rassk keeps his coach south-east of here, short of the east bridge.

bind.journal: Have Spiritmaster Thessik, west of the elder, bind your spirit to the temple island.
bind.says: It is done. If the swamp takes you, it must give you back, here. Now go to Coachman Rassk and give him your name.

ledger.journal: Give your name to Coachman Rassk, south-east of the elder, for his ledger.
ledger.says: A hatchling for the ledger. My coach runs to Freeport and to every other home of the Homelands, for travelers whose names their ledgers hold. Yours is in mine now.

says: Good. The mire knows you now, and so does the road.
Rassk's coach will carry you to Freeport if its ledger knows you, but the road I mean for you is earned. Huntmaster Kessrak, beside me, has work for you.

L3.name: Beetles in the Reeds
offer: The hatchling. Good. Bog beetles are in the reeds on the south shore again, and they eat the eggs of everything, ours too.
Go south round the old temple to the shore, and bring me three of their shells. Then I will teach you something worth the walk.
Will you hunt them?
L3.declined: The beetles thank you. The eggs do not.
L3.started: Three shells. Strike where the wing cases meet.

drop.name: bog beetle shell
drop.description: The green-black shell of a bog beetle from the south shore of the temple island.

hunt.journal: Take three bog beetle shells from the bog beetles on the south shore of the temple island.

give.journal: Bring three bog beetle shells to Huntmaster Kessrak.
give.says: Three shells, cleanly taken. You have patience. Now watch, and learn this.

L4.name: A Hatchling's Arms
offer: Freeport pays for blades, not for claws. I will make you proper gear, but you will bring what I need.
Hidebinder Ssilith has a leather strip and a shaft for me. Then take a fang from the marsh serpents at the south end of the east island, over the bridge.
Will you bring me all three?
L4.declined: Then keep to your claws, and to the shallows.
L4.started: Leather and a shaft from Ssilith. A fang from the serpents. Go.

materials.journal: Ask Hidebinder Ssilith for the leather strip and the wooden shaft.
materials.says: For Kessrak. Yes. A strip of gator leather and a shaft of swamp ash. Tell him the next hide is mine.

drop.name: marsh serpent fang
drop.description: The curved fang of a marsh serpent from the east island of Cazic-Thule.

hunt.journal: Take a marsh serpent fang from the marsh serpents at the south end of the east island.

give.journal: Bring the leather strip, the wooden shaft and the marsh serpent fang to Huntmaster Kessrak.
give.says: All three. Wait... there. The fang sets the edge. It is yours. Keep it dry.

L5.name: Old Snapjaw
offer: One hunt more, hatchling. An old gator we call Snapjaw lies on the north shore, over the north bridge. He has taken two of our fishers, and he is not sorry.
He looks like a log until he moves, and then it is too late. Strike first. Bring me his tooth, and I will teach you the last thing I have for a hatchling.
Will you hunt Old Snapjaw?
L5.declined: He will wait. Gators are good at it. Better than you.
L5.started: North, over the bridge. Do not trust anything that floats.

drop.name: Snapjaw's tooth
drop.description: A yellowed tooth, long as a hand, from the old alligator Snapjaw.

hunt.journal: Take Snapjaw's tooth from the alligator Old Snapjaw on the north shore, over the north bridge.

give.journal: Bring Snapjaw's tooth to Huntmaster Kessrak.
says: Snapjaw's own tooth. The fishers will go north again. You are a hatchling no longer.
Learn this, and see Gatekeeper Vosskar on the east island when you are ready for Freeport.

flight.name: The Road to Freeport
offer: In Freeport the humans pay good coin for a blade that does not tire, and they ask few questions. Kessrak says yours is ready.
You have earned the road, hatchling. I will set you down among your own guild in Freeport, and your spirit will rest there.
Shall I send you to Freeport?
flight.declined: The coin will keep. So will Freeport.
flight.started: Hunt well, and send word home now and then!
flight.journal: Tell Gatekeeper Vosskar when you are ready to go to Freeport.

L7.name: Hides Against the Cold
offer: The homes keep a hunters' outpost on the snow under the Goldfeather Eyrie. The cold there slows our blood, hatchling. A cold Mirewatch hunter is a dead one.
Ride Rassk's coach to the Eyrie. Take two badger pelts and two clumps of rat fur from the snow east of the outpost. I will make you a warm wrap.
Will you hunt the cold snow?
L7.declined: Then stay by the warm mud a while longer.
L7.started: Keep moving out there. When your blood slows, so do you.

drop.name: snowfield badger pelt
drop.description: The thick pelt of a snowfield badger of the Goldfeather Eyrie.

hunt.journal: Take two snowfield badger pelts from the badgers on the snow east of the Eyrie outpost.

drop.name: drift rat fur
drop.description: A clump of white fur from a drift rat of the Goldfeather Eyrie's snow.

hunt.journal: Take two clumps of drift rat fur from the drift rats east of the Eyrie outpost.

give.journal: Bring the badger pelts and the drift rat fur to Huntmaster Kessrak.
give.says: Thick pelts. Good. You hunted in the cold and came back with warm blood. Now learn this.

L10.name: A Spear That Flies True
offer: Your blade has drunk enough. It is time you carried a better one. I have the iron. What I lack are feathers for the balance.
The pale owls of the Eyrie fly the snow north of the outpost. Their pinions are long and straight. Bring me three.
Will you bring me the pinions?
L10.declined: Then your old blade must serve.
L10.started: Three pinions. Owls see well. Come at them low.

drop.name: pale owl pinion
drop.description: A long white flight feather from a pale owl of the Goldfeather Eyrie.

hunt.journal: Take three pale owl pinions from the pale owls north of the Eyrie outpost.

give.journal: Bring three pale owl pinions to Huntmaster Kessrak.
give.says: Straight and white. Good. Iron for the bite, feather for the balance... there. It is yours. Keep it dry.

L13.name: Thinning the Cubs
offer: Word comes by the coach. The frostpaw cubs north of the Eyrie outpost have grown bold, and they take the outpost's snares and its hunters' catch.
A Mirewatch hunter thins a brood before it grows. Kill six of them, then come back to me. Hunt with the other homes if they will have you.
Will you thin the frostpaw cubs?
L13.declined: Then the cubs grow, and the snares stay empty.
L13.started: Six. They are young, not weak.

hunt.journal: Kill six frostpaw cubs on the snow north of the Eyrie outpost.

back.says: Six. The outpost's snares will fill again. You hunt like one of the Mirewatch. Learn this.

L15.name: The Cold That Walks
offer: In the ice caves north-east of the Eyrie outpost there is a thing the hunters call the Rimeheart. Where it walks, the cold grows. Our blood cannot bear it.
Break it. Take a shard to Warden Halvek, so the outpost knows it is done. Then come back to me.
Will you face the Rimeheart?
L15.declined: Then the caves grow colder, and we stay away.
L15.started: Wrap yourself well, and do not go alone.

drop.name: shard of the Rimeheart
drop.description: A shard of blue ice that never melts, broken from the Rimeheart.

hunt.journal: Take a shard from the Rimeheart, in the ice caves north-east of the Eyrie outpost.

carry.journal: Bring the shard of the Rimeheart to Warden Halvek at the Eyrie outpost.
carry.says: A lizard of the Mirewatch broke the Rimeheart, in this cold? I will tell every home. Tell Kessrak the outpost owes the Mirewatch.

back.says: Halvek's word came by the coach. The cold is broken, and you are still warm. Learn this, the last thing I have.

L20.name: The Watcher's Spear
offer: Kessrak says you are a hatchling no longer. Good. The Mirewatch has always kept watch. Now it keeps watch for the other homes as well.
Their scout, Feyla, watches the Goldfeather eyrie from the river north-east of their outpost. Go and lend her your spear. Then come back to me.
Will you keep the watch?
L20.declined: The watch waits. It always waits.
L20.started: Rassk's coach will take you. Watch well.

road.journal: Find Scout Feyla on the frozen river, north-east of the Eyrie outpost.
road.says: A Mirewatch spear? Good, I need one. The Goldfeather raiders carry their eyrie's war-talons. Take three, and they will stay off the river.

drop.name: Goldfeather war-talon
drop.description: A war-talon of the Goldfeather aviaks, bound in gold thread.

hunt.journal: Take three war-talons from the Goldfeather raiders round the eyrie east of the Eyrie outpost.

handin.journal: Bring the three war-talons to Scout Feyla.
handin.says: Three talons. The river is quiet. Tell Warden Halvek the watch was kept, then go home.

after.journal: Tell Warden Halvek at the Eyrie outpost that the watch was kept.
after.says: Feyla's signal came already. The Mirewatch kept our watch. Go home, hunter, and tell your elder so.

L20.picked: So be it. It is yours.

final.journal: Return to Elder Hsslarn in the Mirewatch.
final.says: You kept the watch for every home, and came back to ours. The Mirewatch is proud of you, hunter.
